plan.title: Tiny Wins - Local Accomplishments App
plan.summary: A small browser app that creates and manages local accomplishments using Python's standard library and SQLite, with persistence and basic browser interface features.
features: Persistence check that creates an entry, restarts the server, and confirms that same entry remains

checks.name: Create a new accomplishment
checks.request_body_optional_reason: Adding a description and timestamp is required for persistence.

manual_checks.name: Add an accomplishment through the browser
steps: Open the browser and navigate to the app.
Fill out the form with a description and timestamp.
Click the 'Add' button.
manual_checks.expected: The new accomplishment appears in the list.

tasks.title: Add timestamp field to task creation
tasks.instructions: Modify app.py to include a timestamp in the task creation API. Use the current timestamp from Python's datetime module. Update test_app.py to validate the timestamp is included in the response.
tasks.outcome: POST /api/tasks includes a timestamp in the created task.
done_when: POST /api/tasks returns a task with a timestamp.

interfaces.contract: Returns a ThreadingHTTPServer instance.
Tests the health and home endpoints.

tasks.title: Add timestamp to task creation API response
tasks.instructions: Update test_app.py to assert that the created task includes a timestamp field with ISO 8601 format.
tasks.outcome: POST /api/tasks includes a timestamp in the created task.
done_when: POST /api/tasks returns a task with a timestamp.

interfaces.contract: Returns a ThreadingHTTPServer instance.
Tests the health and home endpoints.
